title: Colonial Theatre sets its holiday season of concerts, comedy and classic films
summary: The Bridge Street theater's November-December slate includes Broadway at the Colonial on Nov. 21, Ana Gasteyer's holiday show Dec. 3, the locally cast Phoenixville Christmas Spectacular Dec. 5-6 and comic Joe DeRosa Dec. 19. Screenings run from Elf over Thanksgiving weekend through Die Hard on Dec. 23.

title: Reading-to-Philly rail authority starts Amtrak simulations without waiting on federal money
summary: The Schuylkill River Passenger Rail Authority voted Monday to spend $654,000 in state grants on Amtrak operating simulations with Norfolk Southern and SEPTA, which will show what track upgrades the proposed line would need. The planned service would stop in Reading, Pottstown and Phoenixville.

title: Phoenixville's Sloane Hartmetz named WCHA Defender of the Week
summary: The Phoenixville native earned her first weekly conference honor at the University of Minnesota after posting four assists and a plus-eight rating as the Gophers swept Lindenwood.

title: Barbara Cohen receives county's Lifetime Achievement Citizen Planner Award
summary: Chester County 2020 and the county Planning Commission honored Cohen for her work restoring the Foundry Building and the Colonial Theatre and launching the Phoenixville Mural Project and Renaissance Park. She was first chosen for the award in 2020, but the Oct. 15 ceremony was the first held since the pandemic.

title: Ten Owen J. Roberts seniors named National Merit Commended Scholars
summary: OJR High School says 10 members of its senior class earned Commended Scholar status in the 2027 National Merit Scholarship Program, placing them in the top 5% of the roughly 1.2 million juniors who took last fall's PSAT.
loc: Owen J. Roberts High School, Pottstown

title: Flashlight cemetery tour returns to Washington Memorial Chapel Oct. 30
summary: Washington Memorial Heritage and the King of Prussia Historical Society run their annual Grave Tales at Valley Forge on Friday, Oct. 30, with docent-led walks starting at 5 p.m. The stops include a Flight 93 passenger, a Titanic survivor and Alex Scott of lemonade-stand fame, with cider and cookies afterward.

title: Route 23 Wawa is open in Schuylkill Township
summary: The 24-hour super Wawa at 799 Valley Forge Rd., on the former Exxon site, opened Thursday, Oct. 22 with about 35 full- and part-time jobs after years of planning and delays.

title: Phoenixville Fire Department to hire five full-time firefighters with FEMA grant
summary: The borough says its $974,561 federal SAFER award, matched with borough money, will pay for five new full-time firefighters. Phoenixville was one of only six Pennsylvania departments to win a SAFER grant this cycle.

title: Baithak Indian Cuisine opens in Spring City
summary: A new Indian restaurant, Baithak, has opened on the riverfront at 10 Riverside Dr., according to the Inquirer's Chester County roundup.

title: 45-townhouse plan for Mont Clare heads to Upper Providence planners Nov. 4
summary: HT 140 Whitaker LLC's preliminary plan for 45 townhouses at 140 Whitaker Ave., filed in April, is on the township planning commission's Nov. 4 agenda after appearing before the supervisors on Oct. 19. No decision has been recorded yet.
